claim: Providence Abstract LLC - 2050 Route 27, Suite 209, Somerset (real estate / title category)
problem: Wrong town. The company's own contact page gives '2050 Route 27, Unit 209, North Brunswick, NJ 08902' and the site is branded for South Brunswick/North Brunswick, i.e. Middlesex County, outside the Franklin Township zone.
fix: Remove from the list (or move to the out-of-zone excluded notes) - verify the Route 27 municipal line before any revisit.

claim: Churchill Estates LLC - property management, 103 Churchill Ave, Somerset
problem: Property records and real-estate listings describe 103 Churchill Ave as a single-family colonial house (5 bed / 3.5 bath), not a business premises. No source found showing Churchill Estates LLC operating a property-management office there; the map-listing-only evidence in the entry does not support the claim.
fix: Drop the entry, or re-source it (state business registration + a non-residential office address) before use. Do not keep a residential street address in an outreach list.

claim: Joe Medicare - insurance agency (Medicare), 575 Easton Ave, Apt 14D, Somerset
problem: The published address is an apartment unit (Apt 14D), i.e. the owner's residence. Only a directory listing supports it; this is a personal home address, not a business premises.
fix: Remove the address (and preferably the entry) - keep only the trading name and public business phone if the business is retained at all.

problem: Excluded type: branch of a national staffing chain (Employbridge). The same address and phone (732) 258-0240 are attributed to Remedy Staffing, another Employbridge brand, so the listing may also be stale or duplicated.
fix: Remove as a chain/franchise branch; if the location matters, re-check which brand actually staffs 80 Veronica Ave.

claim: PROMAN Somerset - staffing agency, 84 Veronica Ave, Suite A1010
problem: Excluded type: US branch of a European staffing group (PROMAN Group), not an independent local firm. Directory data also shows a second brand name (Paramount Staffing) at the same suite and phone.

claim: Beasley Media Group (Somerset) - media / marketing, 78 Veronica Ave, Suite B
problem: Excluded type: regional radio conglomerate (publicly traded group) branch. The mapper's own note concedes it is 'not an independent owner-operated business'.
fix: Remove; the entry contradicts the mapper's own inclusion rules.

claim: WFG Somerset - financial planning, 220 Davidson Ave, Suite 110
problem: Excluded type in substance: branded affiliate office of World Financial Group (large multi-level-marketing insurance distribution chain). Only a map listing supports it and the note already flags the affiliation.

claim: T.E. Freuler Agency (A Division of World) - insurance agency, 270 Davidson Ave, Suite 101
problem: Excluded type: now a division of World Insurance Associates, a national acquirer; no longer an independent local agency, as the note itself says.
fix: Remove, or if acquirer-owned agencies are in scope, state that rule and apply it consistently (see next issue).

claim: National / multi-office firms kept in the list (Terracon, GZA GeoEnvironmental, LaBella/Prestige, Roux Associates, Whitman, D&B Engineers, Geo-Technology Associates) with a 'not independent' note
problem: Inconsistent rule application: single-brand chain branches (ProLogistix, PROMAN, Beasley, WFG) were excluded or flagged, while national multi-office B2B chains were kept. Seven of roughly 100 entries are acquirer- or national-chain-owned offices, which brushes against the 'chains and franchises' exclusion.
fix: State one explicit rule (e.g. 'local/independent offices only' or 'multi-office professional firms allowed, consumer chains not') and re-tag every affected entry against it; if the brief excludes chains, cut these seven.

claim: Coverage - Category searches found eligible in-zone businesses that are absent from the list
problem: 8 eligible, non-chain businesses in the zone surfaced in my own category searches and are not on the list: Melillo Consulting (IT, 285 Davidson Ave Ste 202), AMH Real Estate Management (50 Atrium Dr), MEM Property Management (3 Executive Dr Ste 350), D2 Creative (marketing, 399 Campus Dr Ste 309), Hi Caliber IT Solutions (100 Davidson Ave Ste 300), The Tax Prep (802 Hamilton St), Insurico Group LLC (33 Cedar Brook Dr) and All County Title & Abstract (23 Clyde Rd Ste 201). Missing rate is c. 32% of eligible businesses found (17 of 25 already listed) - at or below the 70% bar.
fix: Add the confirmed ones (Melillo, AMH, MEM, D2 Creative) and re-run the IT, property-management, marketing and tax-prep sweeps; the map-only method clearly returned a capped 10-result view per query, missing smaller offices.

claim: Unverified single-directory / no-contact entries: Ellen Anne Adesso CPA (7 Cedar Grove Ln), AR Solutions Inc., Radus Tek Services, Technology Concepts Group International, Platys Group (no address), Medina Tech Solutions (no address or phone), Blackbird Consulting (map categorises it as a warehouse)
problem: Six entries rest on one Cylex page or a map listing with no address at all; none could be independently confirmed operating at the stated Somerset address. They inflate the list and will waste outreach time.
fix: Either verify with a second source before inclusion or drop them into a 'needs verification' bucket rather than the main list.

claim: Source provenance - 60+ entries cite only a Google Maps search URL (e.g. .../search/accountant+near+Somerset,+NJ+08873/@...,/14z) as their source_url
problem: A Maps search URL is not a stable citation: it re-resolves to different results per session and cannot be re-checked by another analyst. Many entries therefore have no reproducible evidence for the specific address/phone claimed.
fix: Cite the individual place page (or the business's own site / a chamber or state filing) for each entry, at minimum for every entry that is actually going to be used for outreach.

claim: Phone numbers that do not match the business's own site: Sypram Software listed as (888) 448-9996; Delta Personnel listed at '3rd Floor, Suite 302'; Dafer Solutions listed as 'Suite 2'
problem: Sypram's own contact page publishes (732) 875-3851 only, not (888) 448-9996. deltaStaffing's contact page gives Suite 100 (not 302) at 285 Davidson Ave. Dafer's site gives Suite 3 at 2 Camner Ave (list says Suite 2). Minor, but these are the details a caller uses.
fix: Correct against the firms' own contact pages; where only a toll-free line exists, record both numbers.

claim: Zone attribution method - township membership was assigned by Nominatim reverse geocoding of map coordinates
problem: Reverse geocoding on the New Brunswick / Franklin line is unreliable at the building level (the mapper itself flags three Route 27 addresses as borderline). At least one entry (Providence Abstract) survived with a clearly non-Somerset address, so the check was not applied consistently.
fix: Re-check every Route 27, Easton Ave and Livingston Ave address against municipal tax/parcel records or the NJ municipal boundary file, and re-run the borderline cases.
